rescored.reason: The published grant was the SYNTHESIZED one, and that synthesis rested on a phantom path. The script opens `builderror.log` relative; macOS spawns lifecycle scripts with posix_spawn addchdir_np, so no chdir syscall fires and the decoder resolved it against the inherited wrapper cwd, producing <project>/builderror.log — a path no process touched — which billed write.project. The real file is <project>/node_modules/ttf2woff2/builderror.log, exactly where Linux recorded it.
